redeck_desc: Official API of ReDeck. This version will allow you to manage some modules and some system tweaks...
load_module_desc: Query that will allow to load a module. The mechanism that will allow that is from Core.
information_core_desc: Collect some interesting datas about ReDeck !
restart_desc: Search the PID of the ReDeck process. Because ReDeck is managed by systemctl, ReDeck will load again if no process is detected...
is_imported_desc: Looking if specified module has been already loaded !
show_route_desc: Permit to list routes open by FastAPI and check after import !
